name: Suezen! ~Tane o Nozomu Kanojo~
original_name: すえぜん！～種を望む彼女～
source:
Protagonist was living alone until the day that a girl that he used to attend junior high together appeared at his door and said that she wants to have his baby. He fulfilled her request and had sex with her. What started as a surprising event become commonplace when one after another different girls kept coming to him with the same demand. 

He later found out that somehow those girls learned that his genes have the ability to conceive a child that would exactly be like their mom. After learning the truth he decided to offer all the help he can...

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=270745]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
主人公独自生活着，直到有一天，一个他初中时的同学出现在他家门口，说想怀上他的孩子。他满足了她的请求，与她发生了关系。这件令人惊讶的事很快就变得司空见惯——接二连三地有不同的女孩带着同样的要求找上门来。

后来他发现，这些女孩不知从哪里得知，他的基因有能力让她们生下一个和母亲一模一样的孩子。得知真相后，他决定尽己所能提供帮助……

[译自[url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=270745]Getchu[/url]]
